http_recipe.intro: This file documents the currency_pairs resource over HTTP, one section per endpoint. Every section exports its own Hurl file into =projects/ores.http/scripts/library/=. Running a file sends that one request, so a failure names the endpoint it came from.
http_recipe.title: How do I call the currency_pairs endpoints over HTTP?

commands.commentary: Reads one page of the collection. Nothing addresses it but the caller's tenant, so it is the read that shows what exists.
commands.heading: list
commands.subject: refdata.v1.currency_pairs.list

commands.commentary: Reads one page of the rows that share a relation value. The relation is part of the address rather than a filter applied after the read.
commands.heading: by-base-id
commands.subject: refdata.v1.currency_pairs.list_by_base_id

commands.commentary: Reads the one row its key addresses. A key states every identifying column, so a partial key is refused rather than answered with an arbitrary row.
commands.heading: get
commands.subject: refdata.v1.currency_pairs.get

commands.commentary: Writes a row. The change states that the row must not exist, so a create that collides with an existing row is refused rather than replacing it. The change carries a reason and a commentary, which the server records on it so the row's history says why it moved.
commands.heading: add
commands.subject: refdata.v1.currency_pairs.put

commands.commentary: Writes a row. The change states no precondition, so it replaces whatever row the key already addresses. The change carries a reason and a commentary, which the server records on it so the row's history says why it moved. Passing --version makes the write conditional on the version the caller last read.
commands.heading: set
commands.subject: refdata.v1.currency_pairs.put

commands.commentary: Writes several rows in one request. The count states how many field groups follow. The change carries a reason and a commentary, which the server records on it so the row's history says why it moved.
commands.heading: put-many
commands.subject: refdata.v1.currency_pairs.put_many

commands.commentary: Removes a row. The change carries a reason and a commentary, which the server records on it so the row's history says why it moved. Passing --version makes the write conditional on the version the caller last read.
commands.heading: delete
commands.subject: refdata.v1.currency_pairs.delete

commands.commentary: Removes several rows in one request. The change carries a reason and a commentary, which the server records on it so the row's history says why it moved.
commands.heading: delete-many
commands.subject: refdata.v1.currency_pairs.delete_many

commands.commentary: Reads the row's recorded history, newest first.
commands.heading: versions
commands.subject: refdata.v1.currency_pairs_versions.list

commands.commentary: Reads one recorded version of the row.
commands.heading: version
commands.subject: refdata.v1.currency_pairs_versions.get
